_comment: Measured QER of each PROMPTED model organism. A prompted MO is a clean base model plus a quirk instruction in context, with no training. These readings exist so that a match target derived from one is a NAMED, traceable quantity rather than a bare literal: `targets=[0.6506]` in a reproduce command is uninterpretable on its own, and 0.6506 is milsub_gemma's trigger rate.

provenance.measured_by: prompted_mo/ tooling (build_prefixed.py for prefix delivery, eval_worker_system.py for system-turn delivery), which shells out to the same automo.eval_worker every other reading in this repo uses
provenance.why_not_automo_match: `automo match`'s reference_model= takes a Hub model id. A prompted MO is a base model PLUS an instruction, and injecting the instruction lives outside src/automo/ by design, so its rate cannot be measured through the reference path and had to be supplied as an absolute `targets=[...]` level.
provenance.transcribed_from: the campaign log, which is the only surviving record: the per-checkpoint results.json for these readings lived under runs/ and is gone.
provenance.NOT_re_derived: These numbers are transcribed, not recomputed. Re-deriving them needs the local prompt sets rebuilt (prompted_mo/build_prefixed.py; scripts/check_hub.py lists 18 unbuilt sets) and a fresh sweep. Treat them as a record of what was measured then, under the pre-2026-09-16 judge routing.
provenance.conditions: validation split, match phase, n=435, 1 pass, the same rubric each family's spec declares
